import requests, numpy as np, json
from collections import defaultdict

from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle

MOUSE="MEELRCPEAKLAPPEVVIATEAPPPSLVDRYFTRWYKADVKGKPCEDHCILQHSNRICVITLAGSHPVLQSGKAIQRISYQISNNCSRLENKVSGKFKRGAQFLTELAPLCKIYCSDGEEYTISSCVRGRLMEVNENILHQPSLLQEKPSTEGYIAVVLPKFEESKSVTEGLLTQQQYEEVVVKRTNATATTP"
L=len(MOUSE)
# --- recompute conservation (stateless executor) ---
lines=S.get('https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream?query=xref:panther-PTHR13651'
            '&fields=accession,organism_name,lineage,length,sequence&format=tsv',timeout=300).text.strip().split('\n')
hdr=lines[0].split('\t'); recs=[dict(zip(hdr,l.split('\t'))) for l in lines[1:]]
GROUPS=['Chordata','Arthropoda','Nematoda','Mollusca','Cnidaria','Echinodermata','Placozoa','Porifera',
        'Viridiplantae','Fungi','Stramenopiles','Alveolata','Euglenozoa','Amoebozoa','Rhodophyta']
def grp(r):
    g_=r.get('Taxonomic lineage','')
    for g in GROUPS:
        if g in g_: return g
    return 'other'
bg=defaultdict(list)
for r in recs:
    if 100<=int(r['Length'])<=400: bg[grp(r)].append(r)
rng=np.random.default_rng(1); sample=[]
for g,v in bg.items():
    seen=set(); uu=[]
    for r in v:
        o=r['Organism'].split('(')[0].strip()
        if o not in seen: seen.add(o); uu.append(r)
    k=min(30 if g=='Chordata' else 20,len(uu)); sample+=[uu[i] for i in rng.choice(len(uu),k,replace=False)]
B62="""A R N D C Q E G H I L K M F P S T W Y V
A 4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
R -1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2 0 6 1 -3 0 0 0 1 -3 -3 0 -2 -3 -2 1 0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3

L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1

V 0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
rw=B62.strip().split('\n'); AAL=rw[0].split(); SM={}
for r in rw[1:]:
    p=r.split(); SM[p[0]]={AAL[i]:int(p[i+1]) for i in range(20)}
AAIDX={a:i for i,a in enumerate(AAL)}
def nw(s1,s2,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2); NEG=-10**9
    s2i=[AAIDX.get(c,-1) for c in s2]; srows=[[SM.get(c,{}).get(b,-4) for b in AAL] for c in s1]
    Mp=[NEG]*(m+1);Xp=[NEG]*(m+1);Yp=[NEG]*(m+1);Mp[0]=0
    for j in range(1,m+1): Yp[j]=go+ge*(j-1)
    PT=[];PX=[];PY=[]
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        sr=srows[i-1];Mc=[NEG]*(m+1);Xc=[NEG]*(m+1);Yc=[NEG]*(m+1);Xc[0]=go+ge*(i-1)
        pt=[0]*(m+1);px=[0]*(m+1);py=[0]*(m+1)
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            jj=s2i[j-1];s=sr[jj] if jj>=0 else -4
            a,b,c=Mp[j-1],Xp[j-1],Yp[j-1]
            if a>=b and a>=c: Mc[j]=a+s;pt[j]=0
            elif b>=c: Mc[j]=b+s;pt[j]=1
            else: Mc[j]=c+s;pt[j]=2
            a,b,c=Mp[j]+go,Xp[j]+ge,Yp[j]+go
            if a>=b and a>=c: Xc[j]=a;px[j]=0
            elif b>=c: Xc[j]=b;px[j]=1
            else: Xc[j]=c;px[j]=2
            a,b,c=Mc[j-1]+go,Xc[j-1]+go,Yc[j-1]+ge
            if a>=b and a>=c: Yc[j]=a;py[j]=0
            elif b>=c: Yc[j]=b;py[j]=1
            else: Yc[j]=c;py[j]=2
        PT.append(pt);PX.append(px);PY.append(py);Mp,Xp,Yp=Mc,Xc,Yc
    i,j=n,m;st=0 if (Mp[m]>=Xp[m] and Mp[m]>=Yp[m]) else (1 if Xp[m]>=Yp[m] else 2); col=['-']*n
    while i>0 and j>0:
        if st==0: col[i-1]=s2[j-1];st=PT[i-1][j];i-=1;j-=1
        elif st==1: st=PX[i-1][j];i-=1
        else: st=PY[i-1][j];j-=1
    return col
A=np.array([nw(MOUSE,r['Sequence']) for r in sample])

print("col117 composition across %d orthologs:"%len(A), {k:int(v) for k,v in zip(*np.unique(A[:,116],return_counts=True)) if v>3})

# --- structure ---
meta=S.get('https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/Q80ZQ9',timeout=90).json()[0]
pdb=S.get(meta['pdbUrl'],timeout=90).text
at=[(l[12:16].strip(),int(l[22:26]),float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54]),float(l[60:66]),l[76:78].strip())
    for l in pdb.splitlines() if l.startswith('ATOM')]
XYZ=np.array([[a[2],a[3],a[4]] for a in at]); RI=np.array([a[1] for a in at]); EL=[a[6] for a in at]
R=np.array([{'C':1.70,'N':1.55,'O':1.52,'S':1.80}.get(e,1.7) for e in EL]); PR=1.4
nsp=92; g=(1+5**0.5)/2; k=np.arange(nsp)
SP=np.stack([np.sin(np.arccos(1-2*(k+.5)/nsp))*np.cos(2*np.pi*k/g),
             np.sin(np.arccos(1-2*(k+.5)/nsp))*np.sin(2*np.pi*k/g), 1-2*(k+.5)/nsp],1)
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
tree=cKDTree(XYZ); sasa=np.zeros(len(at))
for i in range(len(at)):
    ri=R[i]+PR; pts=XYZ[i]+SP*ri
    nb=[j for j in tree.query_ball_point(XYZ[i],ri+R.max()+PR) if j!=i]
    acc=~np.any(np.linalg.norm(pts[:,None,:]-XYZ[nb][None,:,:],axis=2)<(R[nb]+PR)[None,:],axis=1) if nb else np.ones(nsp,bool)
    sasa[i]=4*np.pi*ri**2*acc.mean()
rs=np.zeros(L+1)
for i,a in enumerate(at): rs[a[1]]+=sasa[i]
MA=dict(A=129,R=274,N=195,D=193,C=167,Q=225,E=223,G=104,H=224,I=197,L=201,K=236,M=224,F=240,P=159,S=155,T=172,W=285,Y=263,V=174)
rel=np.array([rs[i+1]/MA[MOUSE[i]] for i in range(L)])
